# Idempotency opt-out golden list (D4, bd-ws3-contract-breadth-psvyu.4).
#
# Every non-GET route served by the router MUST be replay-verified by
# TestIdempotencyRouterCoverage (internal/serve/idempotency_walk_test.go)
# UNLESS it is enumerated here with a justification. The test enforces the
# ratchet in BOTH directions:
#   - a non-GET route neither replay-verified nor listed here fails the test;
#   - an entry here that no longer resolves to a served route fails the test.
# Adding an opt-out is therefore always a visible, reviewed diff.
#
# Format (tab-separated): METHOD<TAB>chi-route-pattern<TAB>one-line justification
#
# (intentionally empty — every mutating route currently supports replay)
